ios.desc:
Know when to start seeds, when to transplant, and what's ready to pick, all timed to your local frost dates. Map out your beds to scale, see what's growing where all season long, and keep a record of every harvest.

From your first raised bed to a big backyard plot, VegLog is the garden planner and journal for people who grow their own food.

PLAN YOUR BEDS TO SCALE
• Draw raised beds, in-ground beds, community garden plots, greenhouses, hoop houses, and containers in any shape: rectangle, round, L-shaped, or your own
• Lay out crops in squares, blocks, or rows, with the right spacing and a plant count for each block
• Slide through the year to see what's in the bed on any day, and what could go in when a crop comes out
• Advice as you plan: good and bad neighbors (companion planting), crop rotation, frost risk for tender crops, crowded spacing, and crops out of season
• Start from a template, like a salad bed, the three sisters, or kitchen herbs, or let VegLog suggest a plan for the crops you want to grow
• Share a picture of your bed

SOW AT THE RIGHT TIME
• Your last spring and first fall frost dates, worked out for your town from the last few years of Apple Weather data, or enter your own
• A planting chart for every crop, set to your frost dates: when to start indoors, direct sow, transplant, and harvest
• Sow now: everything you can plant this month, at a glance
• Crop plans with succession sowings and reminders, so there's always something coming ready (Pro)

YOUR WEEK IN THE GARDEN
• Today pulls together this week's sowings, to-dos, and crops ready to pick
• Advice from your local forecast: cover tender plants with frost cloth on a frosty night, water early on a hot day, skip watering when rain is on the way
• A roundup of the week ahead every Saturday morning
• A frost alert the evening before a frost, in time to cover tender plants (Pro)
• A Home Screen widget with this week's garden tasks to check off, plus Lock Screen widgets
• Ask Siri what's due in your garden, or log a harvest by voice

A RECORD OF EVERY SEASON
• Log plantings, harvests by weight, notes, and photos
• Look back through your year in the Journal, month by month
• Harvest totals by crop and by bed (Pro)

114 CROPS, AND ROOM FOR YOURS
• Vegetables, herbs, fruit, and flowers, each with sowing depth, spacing, hardiness, companion plants, and a growing tip
• Change any crop to suit your garden, or add your own

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• US or metric units
• Syncs through iCloud between y

I've just released VegLog, a iOS app that helps me track my vegetable growing. I wanted an app that would let me compare my harvest over time, and look for patterns in growing conditions to help me maximise growth.  The app has had some downloads, but no sales yet.
